title: Signs and getting around
focus: Public signs and places: 出口 入口 厕所 男 女 地铁 站 机场 医院 禁止 推 拉 小心 营业时间.
body:
# Signs and getting around

You know all of these words by ear. On a sign they are usually just two to four characters with no context, so you have to recognise them at a glance. Sign language is also a bit more formal than speech: 请勿 instead of 不要, 禁止 instead of 不能.

| Sign | Pinyin | Where you see it |
|---|---|---|
| 出口 / 入口 | chūkǒu / rùkǒu | exit / entrance |
| 厕所 / 洗手间 | cèsuǒ / xǐshǒujiān | toilet / restroom |
| 男 / 女 | nán / nǚ | men's / women's doors |
| 推 / 拉 | tuī / lā | push / pull, on doors |
| 禁止 / 请勿 | jìnzhǐ / qǐng wù | forbidden / please don't |
| 小心 | xiǎoxīn | caution, mind... |
| 地铁 站 机场 医院 | dìtiě zhàn jīchǎng yīyuàn | subway, station, airport, hospital |
| 营业时间 | yíngyè shíjiān | opening hours |

## Examples

- 出口在那边。 chūkǒu zài nàbiān: The exit is over there.
- 厕所在哪儿? cèsuǒ zài nǎr: Where's the toilet?
- 禁止吸烟 jìnzhǐ xīyān: No smoking.
- 禁止停车 jìnzhǐ tíngchē: No parking.
- 小心台阶 xiǎoxīn táijiē: Mind the step.
- 小心地滑 xiǎoxīn dì huá: Caution, wet floor.
- 请排队 qǐng páiduì: Please queue.
- 下一站是机场。 xià yí zhàn shì jīchǎng: The next stop is the airport.
- 在这站换乘二号线。 zài zhè zhàn huànchéng èr hào xiàn: Change here for Line 2.
- 营业时间:早九点到晚十点 yíngyè shíjiān: zǎo jiǔ diǎn dào wǎn shí diǎn: Open 9am to 10pm.
- 电梯坏了,走楼梯吧。 diàntī huài le, zǒu lóutī ba: The elevator's broken, take the stairs.
- 非工作人员禁止入内 fēi gōngzuò rényuán jìnzhǐ rùnèi: Staff only.

## Common mistakes

- **入 vs 人.** 入 (rù, enter) has the right-hand stroke on top; 人 (rén, person) has the left-hand stroke on top. 入口 is the entrance.
- **推 vs 拉.** Both have 扌 (hand) on the left, so look at the right side: 推 has 隹, 拉 has 立.
- **地 in 小心地滑** is dì (floor), not the particle de: "careful, the floor is slippery".

cards.Example: 出口在那边。 chūkǒu zài nàbiān: The exit is over there.
cards.Notes: 出 looks like two 山 stacked; 口 here means an opening

cards.Example: 入口在前面。 rùkǒu zài qiánmiàn: The entrance is up ahead.
cards.Notes: 入 vs 人: in 入 the right-hand stroke is on top

cards.Example: 厕所在哪儿? cèsuǒ zài nǎr: Where's the toilet?
cards.Notes: 厕 = 厂 + 则 zé; 所 is the same one as in 所以

cards.Example: 洗手间在二楼。 xǐshǒujiān zài èr lóu: The restroom is on the second floor.
cards.Notes: 洗 = 氵 water + 先 xiān; 间 = 门 door + 日

cards.Example: 男厕在左边。 náncè zài zuǒbiān: The men's is on the left.
cards.Notes: 男 = 田 field + 力 strength; doors often say just 男

cards.Example: 女厕要排队。 nǚcè yào páiduì: There's a queue for the women's.
cards.Notes: 女 alone on a door means women's; same 女 as in 妈 and 她

cards.Example: 我坐地铁去。 wǒ zuò dìtiě qù: I'll take the subway.
cards.Notes: 铁 = 钅 metal + 失 shī; 地 = 土 earth + 也

cards.Example: 我在地铁站等你。 wǒ zài dìtiězhàn děng nǐ: I'll wait for you at the subway station.
cards.Notes: 立 stand + 占 zhàn for the sound

cards.Example: 我去机场接你。 wǒ qù jīchǎng jiē nǐ: I'll pick you up at the airport.
cards.Notes: 机 = 木 + 几 jī for the sound; 场 = 土 + a place

cards.Example: 他还在医院。 tā hái zài yīyuàn: He's still in hospital.
cards.Notes: 医 = 匚 box + 矢 arrow; 院 has 阝 on the left

cards.Example: 禁止停车 jìnzhǐ tíngchē: No parking.
cards.Notes: 禁 = 林 woods over 示; 止 means stop

cards.Example: 门要推,不要拉。 mén yào tuī, bú yào lā: Push the door, don't pull.
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + 隹 zhuī; compare 拉 with 立 on the right

cards.Example: 这个门是拉的。 zhège mén shì lā de: This door is a pull.
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + 立 lì; compare 推 with 隹 on the right

cards.Example: 小心台阶 xiǎoxīn táijiē: Mind the step.
cards.Notes: Literally 'small heart'; the standard warning-sign word

cards.Example: 营业时间:早九点到晚十点 yíngyè shíjiān: zǎo jiǔ diǎn dào wǎn shí diǎn: Open 9am to 10pm.
cards.Notes: 营 has 艹 on top; 业 is also in 作业 and 毕业
暂 = 斩 zhǎn + 日; 停 = 亻 + 亭 tíng for the sound

cards.Example: 停车场在地下一层。 tíngchēchǎng zài dìxià yī céng: The car park is on B1.
cards.Notes: 车 is car; 场 is the same as in 机场

cards.Example: 电梯坏了,走楼梯吧。 diàntī huài le, zǒu lóutī ba: The elevator's broken, take the stairs.
cards.Notes: 梯 = 木 wood + 弟 dì for the sound
The green running-man sign; 安全 = safe

cards.Example: 售票处在哪儿? shòupiàochù zài nǎr: Where's the ticket office?
cards.Notes: 票 = 西 over 示; also in 车票 and 门票

cards.Example: 在这站换乘二号线。 zài zhè zhàn huànchéng èr hào xiàn: Change here for Line 2.
cards.Notes: 换 = 扌 + 奂 huàn; 乘 is the formal word for 'ride'

cards.Example: 公交车来了! gōngjiāochē lái le: The bus is here!
cards.Notes: Bus stops say 公交站; 交 is also in 交通

cards.Example: 前面路口左转。 qiánmiàn lùkǒu zuǒzhuǎn: Turn left at the next intersection.
cards.Notes: 左 has 工 at the bottom; 右 (right) has 口

cards.Example: 附近有银行吗? fùjìn yǒu yínháng ma: Is there a bank nearby?
cards.Notes: 行 is háng here, but xíng in 自行车 and 不行
地 here is dì (floor), not the particle de
勿 is formal 'don't'; 匆 (cōng) has one more stroke inside
排 = 扌 + 非 fēi; 队 = 阝 + 人
非 means 'not': literally 'non-staff are forbidden to enter'
